item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 22/Nov/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak over the coastal areas of southern China tomorrow. The weather will be generally fine over the region. It will be warm and dry during the day. A strong northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong on Friday. It will be windier over the region during the weekend. Under the influence of a continental airstream, it will be mainly fine and dry over southern China early to midweek next week.
